chunks: That is because they preferred the life of this world over the Hereafter; and indeed, God does not guide the people who disbelieve.
ai.seo_question: Why does God not guide the disbelievers according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological root of disbelief as a deliberate preference for the transient allure of dunya over the permanence of the akhirah, a choice that leads to divine 'closing' of their hearts. This concept of 'tadhlil' (God causing to go astray) is understood not as arbitrary, but as a consequence of their own active choice to 'prefer' (istahabbu) worldly pleasures, thereby losing the capacity for further guidance.
